name: Ivan Gundulić
bio: Ivan Gundulić (Giovanni Gondola, 1589–1638) was a poet and dramatist of the Republic of Ragusa (Dubrovnik), born into a patrician family and later a senator and judge of the city. He wrote in the Ragusan Croatian of his city, and is the central poet of Croatian Baroque literature.

His pastoral drama Dubravka (1628), which closes with a celebrated hymn to liberty, and his unfinished epic Osman, on the Polish–Ottoman war of 1621, are his best-known works; his religious poem Suze sina razmetnoga (Tears of the Prodigal Son) appeared in 1622.
